## Download / 下载

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon M1–M4) | `ForensicEngine-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| **Windows** 10/11 (64-bit) | `ForensicEngine-windows-x64-setup.exe` (or `.msi`) |
| **Linux** (x64) | `ForensicEngine-linux-x64.AppImage` (or `.deb`) |

Everything runs locally — nothing leaves your machine. On first launch the app installs the local AI
runtime (Ollama) and downloads a model (~4.7 GB) automatically (Linux: install [Ollama](https://ollama.com/download) yourself).
全部在本机运行,数据不出你的电脑。首次启动会自动安装 Ollama 并下载模型(约 4.7GB)。

### macOS
1. Open the `.dmg` and drag **Forensic Engine** into **Applications**. / 打开 dmg,把应用拖进「应用程序」。
2. First launch: if macOS says it can't verify the developer, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**
   and click **Open Anyway** (once). / 首次打开若提示无法验证开发者:系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 「仍要打开」(只需一次)。

### Windows
Run the installer (no admin needed). If SmartScreen warns: **More info → Run anyway**.
运行安装程序(无需管理员)。若 SmartScreen 拦截:「更多信息 → 仍要运行」。
